extension.summary: Reusable Go-backed browser-style HTTP client across Kodi operating systems
extension.description: A Python interface with platform-selected native Go shared libraries. Supports Android, Linux, Windows and macOS once each native binary is built. Supports platform-specific native binaries, including Windows ARM64 and legacy x86 when built. Native libraries are XZ-compressed and loaded on demand.
